They manage financial operations of companies such as the assets, liabilities, equity and cash flow aiming to maintain the financial health of the company and operative viability. Financial managers evaluate the strategic plans of the company in financial terms, maintain transparent financial operations for taxation and auditing bodies, and create the financial statements of the company at the end of the fiscal year.

ALTLABELS:

employee volunteering programme coordinator
DESCRIPTION: Employee volunteering programme coordinators work across sectors and fields to coordinate and manage the employee volunteering (sometimes called corporate volunteering) programme for their employer. They are in charge of connecting with local community organisations to determine needs and arrange for volunteers from within the staff of the company to engage with local entities, such as local authorities or local civil society organisations, to meet those needs. Employee volunteering programme coordinators might also arrange for volunteers to undertake their duties online in collaboration with civil society initiatives meeting identified needs. These roles can exist in the company or setting where the employees are based and also in the civil society organisation who receives the volunteers from the employee or corporate volunteering scheme.

DESCRIPTION_SW: Waratibu wa mpango wa kujitolea wa wafanyakazi hufanya kazi katika sekta na nyanja mbalimbali ili kuratibu na kusimamia mpango wa kujitolea wa wafanyakazi (wakati mwingine huitwa kujitolea kwa shirika) kwa mwajiri wao. Wana jukumu la kuungana na mashirika ya jamii ya mahali hapo ili kubaini mahitaji na kupanga wafanyakazi wa kujitolea kutoka ndani ya kampuni ili kushirikiana na vyombo vya ndani, kama vile mamlaka za mitaa au mashirika ya kiraia ya mahali hapo, ili kukidhi mahitaji hayo. Waratibu wa mpango wa kujitolea wa wafanyakazi wanaweza pia kupanga wafanyakazi wa kujitolea kutekeleza majukumu yao mtandaoni kwa ushirikiano na mipango ya mashirika ya kiraia inayokidhi mahitaji yaliyobainishwa. Majukumu haya yanaweza kuwepo katika kampuni au mazingira ambapo wafanyakazi wapo na pia katika shirika la kiraia linalopokea wafanyakazi wa kujitolea kutoka kwa mpango wa kujitolea wa mfanyakazi au shirika.
SCOPENOTE_SW: Mratibu wa mpango wa kujitolea wa wafanyakazi kwa kawaida hadhibiti wafanyakazi wa kujitolea moja kwa moja bali hufanya kazi kama kiunganishi kati ya mwajiri na shirika la kujitolea ambalo wafanyakazi watajitolea nalo au kinyume chake.
